card.name: The word limit after a qualifier
card.fires_on: The word "limit" or "limits" after a describing word such as acceptable, expiration, delivery or detection. A few stray linking words like "into" or "over" also trigger it.

modes.label: Limit as a threshold
modes.description: "Limit" names a cutoff or boundary value in a label, such as expiration, delivery or detection limit.
modes.example: 2.8 RUBY-FILL Dose Delivery<< Limit>> The maximum available activity (delivery limit)

modes.label: Within acceptable limits
modes.description: "Limits" ends the phrase "within acceptable limits" in overdose care instructions.
modes.example: Meticulously monitor and maintain, within acceptable<< limits>>, the patient’s vital signs, blood

modes.label: Stray linking words
modes.description: Occasional short linking words such as "into" or "over" in history text.
modes.example: William was born in 1859<< into>> a comfortable middle-class here a continent away
